description:
LUNEXORA is a team of enthusiastic, creative, and innovative individuals participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We are passionate about science, technology, space exploration, and discovering new possibilities. Our team believes that great ideas can become meaningful solutions through teamwork, effective communication, creativity, and determination.

We aim to create a positive and collaborative environment where every team member can share ideas, and exchange knowledge
summary:
The comic LUNA: Legacy on the Moon follows the adventure of two teenagers and their helper robot, LUNA, as they explore old space technology on the Moon:   

Finding a Moon Rover: They discover an old Apollo 17 Lunar Roving Vehicle that is still in good condition and record its data.   

Fixing a Seismic Tool: They reconnect power to a 1972 seismic module, bringing it back to life to detect a live moonquake.   

Valuable Knowledge: Inside an old 1974 lunar outpost, they find crew logs and design notes for a sustainable water recycler. They realize these items are not junk, but valuable knowledge left for future generations.   

Future Goals: After returning safely to Earth, their trip inspires their future plans. The girl wants to study ecology and robotics to protect Earth, while the boy wants to join the space program to build habitats on Mars.
